image_description: A studio shot of a black computer speaker system against a white background. The setup includes a tall, rectangular subwoofer/speaker tower on the right and a smaller, circular satellite speaker mounted on a stand to the left. A cable connects the two units. The larger unit has a textured front grille and control buttons at the base.
